## ✨ Added

- **Full-text search (Apache Tika), optional.** A new **Full-text search (Tika)** dropdown (`false`/`true`) plus a **Tika server URL** field in the template turn on content search: finding words *inside* your files (PDF, Word, Excel, ...), not just file names. Flip the toggle and point it at a separate Apache Tika container (install one from Community Applications, image `apache/tika`, port `9998`; a `-full` tag also OCRs scanned images). The wrapper then wires OpenCloud's search extractor to Tika and switches full-text search on for you (`SEARCH_EXTRACTOR_TYPE=tika`, `SEARCH_EXTRACTOR_TIKA_TIKA_URL`, `FRONTEND_FULL_TEXT_SEARCH_ENABLED=true`, plus `SEARCH_EXTRACTOR_CS3SOURCE_INSECURE=true` for the internal LAN certificate). Off by default, so existing installs are unaffected. Note: only files uploaded or changed after you enable it are content-indexed; existing files are not re-indexed automatically (re-upload or edit them).

## ⚡ Improved

- README gained a **Full-text search (Apache Tika)** section, clarifying that OpenCloud already has built-in name and metadata search and that Tika is the optional content extractor, with the Community Applications setup steps.
